svg.text: Minimum deployment for at most 3 concurrent users · companion to HomeKeep TDD v1.0 (Section 3) · Build, Ship, Shape: Alexa+ track + AWS Builder
Sign in at Cognito managed login (OAuth code + PKCE)
Browser loads the app and posts turns over HTTPS with a Bearer JWT
Chrome converts speech to text and speaks replies; no audio reaches AWS
ALB routes /api/turns to the session and turn API
Every API verifies the JWT against Cognito JWKS
Turns not handled by deterministic guards go to the orchestrator
Orchestrator calls Bedrock Converse with tool use (Haiku 4.5)
Orchestrator calls its tools only through MCP over 127.0.0.1
Channel makes attested confirm / execute calls (hidden from the LLM)
MCP tools invoke domain services (tenant from token only)
Domain writes records, approvals and operation keys to DynamoDB
Domain submits, replaces, cancels and polls demo bookings
Provider simulator keeps slots and requests in DynamoDB
Domain reads published guidance and the withdraw overlay
Domain validates uploads and issues 5-minute presigned GETs
Helper or staff browser uploads documents directly to S3
Staff console reaches /api/staff through the ALB
Staff and admin API call the same domain services
External MCP client calls /mcp with a Cognito token (homekeep/mcp)
Admin CLI calls /api/admin (catalog, faults, purge, reset)
ECS pulls the ARM64 container image from ECR
Task assumes a least-privilege IAM role; no stored secrets
Container writes redacted structured logs to CloudWatch
Budgets emails the owner at 50%, 80% and 100% of USD 75
AgentCore Runtime · Lambda · API Gateway · Step Functions
EventBridge Scheduler · SQS · Knowledge Bases · OpenSearch
Transcribe · Polly · CloudFront · Route 53 · Secrets Manager
Only the HomeKeep container is custom code; everything else is managed.
Tenant scope comes from the token → membership lookup; no tool
Approvals are captured by the channel, never by the model: the
agent's MCP client has no confirm / execute tools and no attestation.
Simulation mode is fixed server-side: H contains no live provider
adapter, so no spoken command or document can trigger real dispatch.
Single task by design: 3 concurrent users need one worker; scale-up
is a task-size change, multi-task is a P change (shared secret).
